title: DeriveBSD UI DataTransfer Receipt (v0.1)

subject.description: Exact subject holding this receipt. For direction=read this is ordinarily the destination/consumer; for direction=write this is ordinarily the source that created the offer.

offer_source_subject.description: Exact subject that created or exposed the offer. For direction=read this is ordinarily the source/exporting side; for direction=write this ordinarily equals subject.

payload_digest.description: Optional digest of the exact transferred payload. When present, detached support/export can verify that the delivered bytes matched the reviewed transfer story and any successor exact-payload binding.

content_source.description: Optional provenance join for payloads copied from a receipted artifact such as OCR/searchable inspection output.

grant_exhausted.description: True for the ordinary single-delivery case: the first successful read-side transfer exhausted the grant, so ordinary recovery after this point is a fresh grant / re-offer rather than replay or clipboard-history resurrection. False is only for an explicit multi-delivery exception lane.

transferred_at.description: ISO8601 time. Successful ordinary transfer must not be later than the joined grant effective_until.

grant_digest.description: Exact digest of the ui.datatransfer.grant artifact consumed or observed for this transfer. Keeps the receipt joinable back to the reviewed transfer policy artifact without reconstructing it from lease_id/offer_id folklore.

description: portable ordinary workstation transfer receipt family. This receipt family is reserved for the frozen ordinary reviewed-transfer baseline; future richer transfer lanes must mint distinct artifact families instead of widening or variant-switching this ordinary baseline receipt family.
